messages:
Maya R: Quick heads-up — vendor asks for a coordinated announcement window for H200 and MI300 next quarter. They want a staggered press but a single marketplace cutover. Thoughts?

Kevin C: Ah — vendor asked for embargo from Apr 10-14, marketplace needs manifest + SKU tags 48h before. Can we do staggered: H200 announce Apr 11, MI300 Apr 13? :thinking_face:

Elena S: Staggered could work if we guarantee capacity backfill. MI300 backfill from EU region will be tight. Need final capacity numbers from infra by EOD tomorrow.

Tom B: Marketplace constraints: onboarding pipeline needs the final image and release tag by Apr 9 COB, otherwise we slip the SKU publish. Also need the `compat-matrix.json` and driver hashes. Example snippet we expect:
```
{
  "sku": "mi300-64",
  "driver": "r75.3",
  "image_tag": "redwood-mi300-2026-04-09"
}
```

Priya N: For SI integrations — partners want a dry-run week before announce. Can we commit to a partner-only dry-run Apr 6-8? That gives them time to validate connectors.

Kevin C: @Priya N that dry-run is fine from our side but only if we have the staging images by Apr 3. Otherwise we can only do smoke tests.

Maya R: Action items: (1) Infra to confirm EU backfill numbers (Elena), (2) Build to cut staging images by Apr 3 (Tom), (3) Marketplace tagging by Apr 9 (Tom), (4) SI dry-run coordination (Priya) — can everyone ack? :thumbsup:

Elena S: Acked. Will ping infra on the numbers now.

Tom B: Acked. I'll schedule build and post manifest link when ready.

Priya N: Acked. I'll confirm partner list + dry-run invites by EOD.

PartnerBot: Meeting created: "HW Announcement Coordination — H200/MI300" Thu Apr 2 10:00 PT. Calendar invites sent to participants.

Maya R: Cool. One more ask from vendor — they need language for the joint release (two short bullets) by Apr 5 so their comms team can prep. I'll draft and drop here tomorrow.

Kevin C: Thanks — will prep a short fallback statement in case capacity backfill slips.

Maya R: Perfect. Keeping this thread for live updates only. If you post anything big, please ping me directly.

Elena S: Will do.

Tom B: FYI — if image cut gets delayed I might propose a minimal manifest hack to unblock marketplace tagging. Will flag if needed.

Priya N: Noted. :white_check_mark:

Maya R: End of thread for now — thanks all!
